# Orvio 0.13

- Account e-mails open Orvio: tap the confirmation link on your phone and Orvio signs you in. "Forgot password?" works the same way and lets you choose a new password.
- After creating an account, a clear "Confirm your e-mail" screen shows where the e-mail went, with "Send the e-mail again".
- Show / Hide for your password, and "Repeat password" when creating an account.
- The Sign in button always responds and tells you what is missing, instead of looking greyed out.

First installation is manual. Existing installations download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it.

Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
